composition_subtypes.role: preprocess: sort legs by energy bucket and then by length for efficient greedy access
greedy selection: traverse sorted structure to pick highest-energy legs with length < current max

payload.core_composition_summary: Iterate over candidate max lengths, for each apply greedy selection of highest-energy shorter legs using pre-sorted energy-length structure.
payload.rationale: Combines sorting (bucket by energy, sort lengths) with greedy algorithm (pick best legs to keep) to minimize removal energy across all maximum length choices.
